JOB TEXT:
Daily rentals report, READ ONLY. Use only these dashboard tools: get_upcoming_bookings, list_bookings, list_rooms, check_availability, get_rentals_dashboard, list_direct_bookings. Never call update_*, cancel_*, restore_*, create_*, push_*, publish_* or propose_* in this job. Report: 1) `New / changed / cancelled` — bookings created, changed or cancelled in the last 24 hours (channel, room, dates, guest name, amount). 2) `Next 48 h` — check-ins and check-outs in the next 48 hours, per room. 3) `Empty nights` — per room, free nights in the next 14 days, as date ranges. 4) `Looks wrong` — double bookings, bookings without a room, missing amounts. Write `none` for an empty section. Your final reply is NOT sent to anyone: it is saved and collected into Mat's 06:30 CEO morning report, so keep it compact, facts only, under 25 lines. If a tool fails, say which one and stop; never guess numbers.
